karnak-temple-complex-begun.research_focus: Middle Kingdom Karnak on the east bank of the Nile at Thebes, the earliest mud-brick and stone sanctuary to Amun, and later columned halls
karnak-temple-complex-begun.scene: Masons set the first sandstone blocks of a sanctuary on the Nile's east bank while labourers drag a block on a wooden sledge, a lone obelisk and a row of columns rising unfinished behind them

abu-simbel-temples-carved.research_focus: Ramesses II's rock-cut temples at Abu Simbel in Nubia, the four seated colossi on the facade, cut into a sandstone cliff above the Nile
abu-simbel-temples-carved.scene: Carvers on wooden scaffolds chisel four colossal seated kings out of a sandstone cliff above a wide river, a shadowed doorway opening between the feet of the statues

parthenon-dedicated-athena.research_focus: the Parthenon on the Athenian Acropolis, Doric columns, sculpted pediments, the great procession of the Panathenaia
parthenon-dedicated-athena.scene: A procession of robed citizens and cattle climbs the steps of a rocky hilltop toward a marble Doric temple with its columns freshly finished, sculptors still working on the pediment high above

prophets-mosque-medina-built.research_focus: the first mosque at Medina, an open courtyard with palm-trunk pillars, a palm-leaf roof and mud-brick walls
prophets-mosque-medina-built.scene: Men stack mud bricks around a square courtyard and lift palm trunks to carry a roof of palm fronds, a plain shaded prayer space taking shape among date palms

great-mosque-cordoba-begun.research_focus: the Great Mosque of Córdoba's hypostyle hall, double-tiered horseshoe arches of alternating stone and brick, columns reused from Roman and Visigothic buildings
great-mosque-cordoba-begun.scene: Builders raise a double tier of horseshoe arches with alternating bands of stone and brick across a forest of reused Roman columns, a citrus-tree courtyard open beyond

westminster-abbey-consecrated.research_focus: Edward the Confessor's Romanesque Westminster Abbey on the Thames, round arches, a long nave, the Bayeux Tapestry's depiction of the church
westminster-abbey-consecrated.scene: A great Romanesque church with heavy round arches and a squat central tower stands by a river, clergy in vestments processing through its west doors while a king's empty chair is carried behind them

florence-cathedral-begun.research_focus: Arnolfo di Cambio's design for Florence cathedral, polychrome marble facing, laying of the foundations in the 1290s on the site of Santa Reparata
florence-cathedral-begun.scene: Labourers dig deep foundation trenches beside the ruins of an older small church while an architect unrolls a plan on a trestle, bundles of marble blocks stacked in a medieval Tuscan piazza

st-basils-cathedral-completed.research_focus: the Cathedral of the Intercession on Red Square, its cluster of onion domes and chapels around a central tent tower, built under Ivan IV
st-basils-cathedral-completed.scene: A cluster of ornate onion domes, each with a different pattern, crowns a brick church beside the Kremlin walls, scaffolding being lowered from the tallest tent-shaped tower

st-pauls-cathedral-completed.research_focus: Christopher Wren's St Paul's Cathedral, its great dome and west towers, the city of London rebuilt after the Great Fire
st-pauls-cathedral-completed.scene: A great stone dome on a colonnaded drum rises above a rebuilt city of brick houses, an older man in a wig and coat looking up at it from a rooftop beside a mason with a plumb line

sagrada-familia-begun.research_focus: the Sagrada Família in Barcelona, its first stone and crypt, later Gaudí's organic towers and branching columns
sagrada-familia-begun.scene: A small crowd gathers in an open building plot on the edge of a city as a foundation stone is lowered into a trench, a model of soaring organic spires held up on a table beside it

salt-lake-temple-dedicated.research_focus: the Salt Lake Temple's granite walls and six spires, built by Latter-day Saint pioneers over four decades with granite hauled from Little Cottonwood Canyon
salt-lake-temple-dedicated.scene: Oxen haul a huge granite block on a wagon toward a nearly finished temple with six spires, with a dry mountain valley and a pioneer town spread out below it

great-mosque-djenne-rebuilt.research_focus: the Great Mosque of Djenné, banco mud-brick walls with protruding toron beams, built beside the Bani River floodplain, the annual replastering
great-mosque-djenne-rebuilt.scene: Townspeople climb the protruding wooden beams of a huge mud-brick mosque, smoothing wet mud over its tall towers while barefoot children carry baskets of mud up to them

coventry-cathedral-consecrated.research_focus: Basil Spence's Coventry Cathedral standing beside the ruined shell of the medieval cathedral, a glass screen and the charred cross of beams
coventry-cathedral-consecrated.scene: A tall modern church with a vast glass wall stands joined to the roofless stone shell of a bombed medieval cathedral, a cross of charred roof beams standing in the ruins between them

hassan-ii-mosque-inaugurated.research_focus: the Hassan II Mosque on the Casablanca waterfront, its tall square minaret, zellige tilework, carved cedar and the retractable roof
hassan-ii-mosque-inaugurated.scene: A vast mosque with a tall square minaret stands at the edge of the Atlantic, waves breaking on the rocks beneath its terrace while artisans lay intricate tile mosaic in the foreground

sheikh-zayed-grand-mosque-opens.research_focus: the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque in Abu Dhabi, its eighty-two domes, four minarets, reflecting pools and marble courtyard
sheikh-zayed-grand-mosque-opens.scene: A sprawling marble mosque with dozens of domes and four slender minarets reflected in long shallow pools, worshippers in long robes crossing a vast courtyard in the early evening

notre-dame-paris-reopens.research_focus: Notre-Dame de Paris after the 2019 fire, the restored roof and spire, the cleaned stone, the reopening
notre-dame-paris-reopens.scene: Craftspeople in hard hats look up at a newly rebuilt oak spire and a freshly cleaned stone facade of a Gothic cathedral on an island in a river, a crowd gathering in the square in front of the doors
